descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Stand on the rampart. Across the field, an archer is already drawing on you.

BOW DUEL VR is a one-on-one archery duel built for Quest. Hold the bow in your left hand, pull the string back with your right, and lob an arrow in a high arc over the wall. Your rival is doing the same to you. One headshot wins. So do two body hits.

EIGHT RIVALS, EIGHT ARENAS
Rookie Rufus, Dusty Dan, Captain Mae, Sister Wren, The Baron, Sir Gallant, Silent Fox and Wall Breaker. Each has their own look, their own battlefield and a longer shot than the last, from 80 to 120 metres, across sunny valleys, snowfields, a dust bowl, a storm and a night duel in a moonlit keep.

READ THE FIELD
Aim high and trust your eye. The wind pushes your arrows sideways and changes every duel, so watch the pennant by the wall and lead into it. The gold pillar shows where your last arrow fell.

SCORE AND PRACTICE
Every duel you win scores points, with bonuses for headshots, quick wins and health left. Your five best runs go on the high score board. Practice mode gives you a target that never shoots back: pick the rival, arena, range and wind and work on your lob.

FOUR KINDS OF ARROW
Standard, Heavy, Swift and Double, swapped with one button.

BUILT FOR THE HEADSET
- Real draw-and-release archery with haptics
- Optional aim line, arc and landing pillar
- Arrow Cam follows your shot in
- Comfortable: you stay on the rampart and nothing moves your view

Eight rivals. One rampart. How high can you score?
